sys_hub_flow.description: Implements LTM Document Pillar 5 (Interview Intelligence & Disagreement Detection), Agent 4 (Feedback Synthesis), and Agent 5 (Hiring Decision Engine). Analyzes panellist recommendations for consensus or divergence, computes cross-channel evidentiary confidence, creates or updates x_snc_aegis_hiring_decision with decision_status=PENDING_HUMAN, and alerts the hiring manager.
